title: Legacy CNC controller runs Windows 7
reason: Machine vendor does not support a newer operating system on this controller
remediation_plan: Replace controller in the 2026 capital budget

title: Shared admin account on HMI panels
reason: Panels support only one local administrator account

title: No MFA on ERP vendor support account
reason: Vendor support tool does not support our MFA provider
compensating_control: Account disabled except during scheduled support windows
remediation_plan: Vendor to move to guest accounts with MFA

title: File server backups use domain admin credentials
reason: Backup software license does not include a separate service identity
compensating_control: Daily copy to an offsite drive rotated weekly

title: USB storage allowed in quality lab
reason: Measuring equipment exports results only to USB

title: PLC network excluded from vulnerability scans
reason: Scans have caused PLC faults in the past

title: Firewall rule allows RDP from vendor IP
reason: Vendor needs remote access for warranty support
compensating_control: Source IP restricted, RDP gateway logs to SIEM
remediation_plan: Replace with vendor VPN and MFA

title: Antivirus disabled on barcode scanners
reason: Scanner OS could not run the antivirus agent

title: Local admin rights on engineering laptops
reason: CAD tools need frequent driver installs
compensating_control: EDR alerts on new admin tools
